final: WITH m AS (SELECT p.death_state AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS overall FROM m), kept AS (SELECT m.st, m.cnt, a.overall FROM m CROSS JOIN avg_c a WHERE m.cnt > a.overall) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(cnt - overall) AS avg_kept_diff FROM kept
